name: fnirsi-psu
description: Control a FNIRSI USB bench power supply: set voltage/current, switch output, read measurements, run sweeps.
long_description: Talks to FNIRSI digitally controlled bench power supplies over their USB virtual COM port, using a protocol reverse-engineered from the official Windows app (V1.0.0.0). Lets Claude read live voltage, current, power, CV/CC mode and protection state; change set-points, protection thresholds and presets; sample measurements over time; and run voltage or current sweeps for IV curves. A software voltage/current cap can be set in the extension settings. Pure Python: the only bundled dependency is pyserial.

tools.name: list_serial_ports
tools.description: List serial/COM ports (the PSU is a USB CDC port)

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Handshake with the PSU and read its full state

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Leave PC-link mode and close the port

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Full state: output, set-points, limits, protections, presets

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Fresh V/I/P reading with CV/CC and protection state

tools.name: set_output
tools.description: Switch the output on or off

tools.name: configure
tools.description: Set voltage, current and output in one call

tools.name: set_protection
tools.description: Set OVP / OCP / OPP / OTP / LVP thresholds

tools.name: apply_preset
tools.description: Load a preset group into the live set-points

tools.name: monitor
tools.description: Sample V/I/P over time with statistics

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: Voltage or current sweep with a measurement at each step

port.title: Serial port
port.description: COM port of the PSU, e.g. COM5 (Windows) or /dev/ttyACM0. Leave empty to pick it at runtime with list_serial_ports + connect.

address.title: Device address
address.description: Address configured on the PSU (1-255). The handshake checks it.

max_voltage.title: Safety voltage cap (V)
max_voltage.description: Refuse set-points above this. 0 = use the device maximum only.

max_current.title: Safety current cap (A)
max_current.description: Refuse current limits above this. 0 = use the device maximum only.

simulate.title: Simulation mode
simulate.description: Use a built-in simulated PSU (10 ohm load) instead of real hardware.
